Democrats are facing internal backlash after 11 of their lawmakers missed a crucial House vote to advance the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, allowing Republicans to block the effort 211–204. 
Some Democrats blamed traffic delays, medical procedures or personal emergencies, while others accused their colleagues of failing to show up for a critical vote. 
Several lawmakers also criticized Democratic leadership over the defeat, which came just days after the party’s midterm victories.
Source: WSJ
